method: Original crop classes on a minimal World with hydrated farmland. Crop subclasses override only the protected drop-spawning method to capture stacks. nextFloat is fixed at 0.5 to isolate the integer harvest rolls (chance 1, fortune 0). Rows cover every age, 256 seeds per crop, original icon indices, same-crop versus wheat-neighbour growth, bone meal, food values, furnace XP and EntityPig.isBreedingItem. Zombie rare-drop eligibility/selection is bytecode-derived, not probe-run.
